name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
description: Bento grid is a layout used to showcase the features of a product in a simple and elegant way.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { FileText } from '@lucide/vue'
import { BentoCard, BentoGrid } from '@/components/ui/bento-grid'
</script>

<template>
  <BentoGrid>
    <BentoCard
      :icon="FileText"
      name="Save your files"
      description="We automatically save your files as you type."
      href="#"
      cta="Learn more"
      class="col-span-3 lg:col-span-1"
    >
      <template #background>
        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-linear-to-br from-sky-400/20 to-transparent" />
      </template>
    </BentoCard>
  </BentoGrid>
</template>

examples.name: bento-grid-demo
examples.title: Features
examples.description: Cards with live backgrounds: Marquee, Animated List and Orbiting Circles.

examples.name: bento-grid-vertical
examples.title: Vertical
examples.description: Place cards on an explicit grid with `lg:row-*` / `lg:col-*` classes.

examples.name: bento-grid-compact
examples.title: Compact
examples.description: Override the row height and column count through `class`.

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the grid. Defaults to three columns with 22rem rows (`auto-rows-[22rem] grid-cols-3`).

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the card — usually its `col-span-*` / `row-*` placement.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component, e.g. from `@lucide/vue` (Magic UI's `Icon` prop). For anything else use the `icon` slot.

props.name: cta
props.description: Call-to-action label, revealed on hover on large screens.

slots.name: background
slots.description: Decorative content behind the text (Magic UI's `background` prop). Position it `absolute`.
